fatigue.inclusionPolicy: Calendar fatigue required by product request; select among fatigue-inclusive candidates, not a claim of better forecast accuracy
assumptions: Each game contributes one workload unit regardless of innings or pitch count
Decay scale selected from candidate definitions, not measured biological recovery
All past activity through previous calendar date; no future observed games
Future games use planned dates plus delays observed so far and minimum travel gap
A new observed date may update championship probability separately from player cWPA

regularPrior.fit: unpenalized logistic, same fatigue feature; previous-calendar-date features

coefficientIntervals.method: season-cluster percentile bootstrap; selected specification fixed

limitations: Fatigue inclusion is a requested modelling choice; validation error is slightly worse than v1 without fatigue
Calendar workload is a proxy, not physiological measurement or a causal fatigue estimate
Seed, strength and workload are confounded; coefficient interval may include zero
Retrospective exploratory evaluation; 2023–2025 outcomes already viewed during earlier development
No individual starters, bullpen pitches, injury or extra-inning weights
Future schedule is a declared scenario, updated only when each actual game begins
Constant log-odds state WP correction remains an approximation
